Current EHR: WellSky – Specialty Inpatient EHR

Job postings from Montrose Behavioral Health Hospital indicate that they use WellSky EHR, with specific references to its utilization in December 2023. A job posting for a Psych Registered Nurse at Montrose Behavioral Health Hospital confirms that they use WellSky as their Electronic Medical Record system.

Yes, Montrose Behavioral Health Hospital in Chicago, IL uses WellSky EHR.

Here’s the evidence:

  • Job Postings: Several job postings for Montrose Behavioral Health Hospital, specifically for the Adult Campus, mention “EMR: WellSky.” These postings are dated December 27, 2023.
  • Registered Nurse Job Description: Mentions utilizing both “EHR-HCS and WellSky EHR for documentation”.

It appears they may use more than one EHR system, but WellSky is definitely in use at Montrose Behavioral Health Hospital.

Based on my search, here’s what I found regarding Montrose Behavioral Health Hospital’s use of WellSky EHR:

  • Confirmation of WellSky EHR: A job posting for a Psych Registered Nurse (RN) at Montrose Behavioral Health Hospital for Children’s Pavilion, dated December 14, 2023, explicitly states “EMR: WellSky.” This confirms that Montrose Behavioral Health Hospital uses WellSky as their Electronic Medical Record system.

It is important to note:

  • The job posting specifies the Children’s Pavilion uses WellSky, so it is likely the adult inpatient and outpatient facilities also utilize this EMR.
